pass_a_gloss: §29 dual gloss: νουμηνία / new-moon · μόσχος / calf · χίμαρος / he-goat … Pass A ≠ Pass B. Theme: Die with Christ; graded flock; goat=Christ.
pass_b_english: Cyril: At the new moon we die and live with Christ. ([[Rom 6:8 >> Bible:Rom 6:8]]; [[Num 28:11-15 >> Bible:Num 28:11-15]])
Two calves mark the two peoples; the goat is Christ for sin; without him we can do nothing. ([[Eph 2:14-16 >> Bible:Eph 2:14-16]]; [[2 Cor 5:21 >> Bible:2 Cor 5:21]]; [[Jn 15:5 >> Bible:Jn 15:5]])
